source.name: Cleveland Browns: Browns and Huntington Bank announce 20-year partnership that includes stadium naming rights
source.quote: The Cleveland Browns and The Huntington National Bank today announced a 20-year partnership that includes the naming rights to the Browns' stadium

note: Arena naming rights: Huntington Bank Field. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2024-09-03.
